name: Nature's Wrath
description:
Attacks have an independent 35% chance each to inflict: ENTANGLE (2 turns), 40 BLEED, 3 THORNS, and POISON (1 turn).

ENTANGLE: Cannot dodge, -20% Damage Dealt, takes 2% Max HP damage each turn.
BLEED: The target receives 1 damage at the start of its turn for every charge, then removes one charge.
THORNS: Takes damage equal to Thorn stacks as a percentage of damage dealt. Loses 1 stack each turn.
POISON: Damage reduced by 20%.
